blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Feedforward foundation models have recently shown remarkable 3D reconstruction capabilities. However, existing models exhibit large tracking drift in long-context streaming reconstruction due to error accumulation. In this paper, we revisit loop closure with streaming reconstruction foundation models to enable accurate, drift-free, kilometer-scale reconstruction. Specifically, our method detects loop candidates through global descriptor retrieval, and constructs loop-conditioned windows to estimate the relative poses between looped frames. Given the observation that our adopted streaming reconstruction backbone produces a globally consistent scale, we optimize all frame poses on the SE(3) manifold with sequential and loop closure constraints, avoiding the pose graph optimization on the Sim(3) or higher-dimensional SL(4) manifolds employed in prior works. Extensive experiments show that our method reduces drift and produces consistent geometry on kilometer-scale sequences, significantly outperforming the state of the art. Code is available at https://github.com/MoyangLi00/CLoSeR.git .
blocks.zh: FeedForward基础模型最近显示出显著的立体重建能力. 然而,由于误差累积,现有模型在长文串流重建中显示出了巨大的跟踪漂移. 在本文中,我们重新审视以流畅的重建基础模型进行循环关闭,以便能够进行准确、无漂流和千米规模的重建。 具体地说,我们的方法通过全域描述符检索来检测回路对象,并构造回路条件窗口来估计回路框之间的相对外观. 鉴于我们采用的流体重建主干线产生了全球一致的尺度,我们优化了SE(3)上所有框架的多面并有相继和环闭合的限制,避免了Sim(3)或前期工程使用的更高维SL(4)多面的姿势图优化. 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法能减少漂移,并在千米尺度的序列上产生相容的几何学,大大地超过了最先进的水平. 代码见https://github.com/MoyangLi00/CLOSeR.git.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Accurate geometry and pose estimation from a sequence of images are fundamental yet challenging tasks in 3D vision, with broad applications in robotics ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Arm et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ) and autonomous driving ( Badue et al., 2021 ; Geiger et al., 2013 ) . Traditional approaches address this problem by leveraging multi-view geometric constraints, ranging from feature-based pipelines ( Mur-Artal et al., 2015 ; Mur-Artal and Tardós, 2017 ; Campos et al., 2021 ) that triangulate sparse keypoints across frames, to direct methods ( Engel et al., 2017 ; Engel et al., 2014 ) that minimize photometric residuals over image intensities. To achieve more robust estimation under challenging conditions, additional sensors such as inertial measurement units (IMU) ( Qin et al., 2018 ; Leutenegger, 2022 ) and LiDAR ( Zhang et al., 2014 ; Shan et al., 2020 ; Xu and Zhang, 2021 ) are commonly fused into the pipeline. Moreover, some systems have extensively studied loop closure detection ( Gálvez-López and Tardos, 2012 ; Arandjelovic et al., 2016 ) and pose graph optimization ( Kümmerle et al., 2011 ; Kaess et al., 2012 ) , to correct the tracking drift over long trajectories and large-scale scenes.
blocks.zh: 精确的几何和从图像序列中作出平面估计,是3D视觉中根本性而具有挑战性的任务,在机器人学(刘等,2024;Arm等,2023;周等,2022)和自主驾驶(Badue等,2021;Geiger等,2013.)中都有广泛的应用. 传统方法通过利用多种角度的几何限制来解决这一问题,这些限制包括基于地物的管道(Mur-Artal等,2015年;Mur-Artal和Tardós,2017年;Campos等,2021年),这些管道跨越了框架,将稀有的关键点三角化,以及直接方法(Engel等,2017年;Engel等,2014年)。 为了在有挑战性的条件下实现更强的估算,惯性测量单元(IMU)(秦等,2018;勒特内格尔,2022;李达AR(张等,2014;掸等,2020;许和张等,2021)等额外传感器通常被熔入管道. 此外,一些系统还广泛研究了环闭探测(Gálvez-López和Tardos,2012;Arandjelovic等,2016年)并设置了图样优化(Kümmerle等,2011;Kaess等,2012年),以纠正在长轨和大规模场景上的跟踪漂移.

blocks.en: Recently, feedforward foundation models have shifted the paradigm in 3D vision. Early works ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Leroy et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025a ) estimate dense two-view geometry and camera poses with transformers, and rely on pairwise alignment to handle multiple frames. VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) extends this paradigm to multi-frame inputs, jointly predicting camera poses, depth maps, dense point clouds, and camera intrinsics in a single forward pass. However, the O ⁡ ( n 2 ) O(n^{2}) computational complexity of self-attention layers and its non-causal architecture prevent VGGT from scaling to long sequences or supporting streaming inference.
blocks.zh: 最近,向导基础模型在3D愿景中改变了范式. 早期作品 (Wang等, 2024b; Leroy等, 2024;Chen等, 2025a) 估算出有变压器的稠密双景几何和相机外形,并依靠对接来处理多帧. VGGT (Wang et al., 2025a.)将这个范式扩展到多帧输入,联合预测相机的姿势,深度图,密集点云,以及相机内在的单个前传. 然而,O QQ (n 2) O(n^{2}) 自意层及其非因果结构的计算复杂性使得VGGT无法缩放为长序或支持流推论.

blocks.en: Several approaches extend feedforward backbones to long-sequence and sequential reconstruction. Some streaming approaches adopt online updates of global memory representation ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025b ) or Test-Time Training (TTT) layers ( Zhuo et al., 2025 ; Elflein et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) to propagate information across windows to enable long-context reconstruction. However, they still suffer from tracking drift over long trajectories due to the lack of explicit constraints imposed on revisited regions. Submap-based approaches ( Maggio et al., 2025 ; Maggio and Carlone, 2026 ; Deng et al., 2025 ) instead partition the sequence into chunks, independently infer the geometry and camera poses of each submap, and align them through point clouds registration. These approaches further incorporate loop closure to mitigate drift. However, since each submap is produced by an independent forward pass of VGGT, scale inconsistency inevitably arises across submaps. As a consequence, the resulting pose graph has to be optimized on the Sim(3) ( Deng et al., 2025 ) or even higher-dimensional SL(4) ( Maggio et al., 2025 ; Maggio and Carlone, 2026 ) manifold to absorb scale or projective ambiguity. However, the relative poses and scales recovered through point cloud registration remain noisy and unreliable, as shown in Fig. 1 , which substantially limits their performance in real-world complex scenarios.
blocks.zh: 几种方法将向导的主干扩大到长序和相继重建。 一些流化方法采用在线更新全球记忆表述(Wang等人,2025b; Chen等,2025b.)或Test-Time Training (TTT)分层(Zhuo等,2025;Elflein等,2026;Jin等,2026;Zhang等,2026)将信息传播到窗外,可以进行长文重建. 然而,由于缺乏对重新审视过的区域施加的明确限制,它们仍然在跟踪长期轨道上的漂移。 基于子地图的方法(Maggio等人,2025年;Maggio和Carlone,2026年;Deng等人,2025年)取而代之的是将序列分割成块,独立地推断出每个子地图的几何和相机外观,并通过点云登记来对齐. 这些办法进一步包括封闭循环以减少漂移。 然而,由于每个子图都是由VGGT的独立前传而来,所以尺度不一致不可避免地在子图之间产生. 因此,所产生的平面图必须优化于Sim(3)(Deng等人,2025年)或更高级的SL(4)(Maggio等人,2025年;Maggio和Carlone,2026年)以吸收尺度或投影模糊。 然而,如图1所示,通过点云登记恢复的相对姿势和尺度仍然很吵并不可靠,这大大限制了其在现实世界复杂情况下的表现。

blocks.en:
This raises a natural question: can loop closure be made simpler and more reliable when built upon a streaming backbone whose global scale is already consistent? In this paper, we present CLoSeR , a streaming reconstruction system that augments a prior streaming backbone LoGeR ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) with loop closure for accurate kilometer-scale reconstruction from uncalibrated monocular videos.
Our approach exploits two key properties of LoGeR: (a) its pose predictions across windows share a globally consistent scale, rendering pose graph optimization on the SE(3) manifold sufficient and avoiding the Sim(3) or SL(4) manifolds used in prior submap-based methods; (b) its window-wise inference does not require temporal contiguity of input frames, allowing us to append a loop-conditioned window comprising the current and revisited frames after the regular streaming windows, and to directly recover their relative poses in the global coordinate frame.

我们的方法利用了LoGeR的两个关键特性:(a) 其跨窗口的外观预测具有全球一致的尺度,使SE(3)的多面图优化足够,并避免以前基于子图的方法中使用的Sim(3)或SL(4)的多面图;(b) 其视窗推断不需要输入框架的时间连续性,使我们能够附加一个循环条件的窗口,包括当前和正常流出窗口之后的再审框架,并直接恢复其在全球坐标框架中的相对位置。

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are as follows: • We present a system that integrates loop closure into streaming feedforward reconstruction models, enabling accurate kilometer-scale reconstruction from monocular videos. • We propose a simple yet effective loop-conditioned window mechanism that exploits the streaming nature of the backbone to recover relative poses between looped frames in a globally consistent coordinate frame. • We show that, owing to the globally consistent scale, pose graph optimization on the SE(3) manifold is sufficient for accurate large-scale reconstruction, obviating the Sim(3) or SL(4) optimization and the point-cloud alignment adopted by prior submap-based methods.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的主要贡献如下: 我们提出一个系统,将环闭式连接纳入流线式向前进的重建模型,从而能够从单相机视频中精确地进行千米规模的重建。 我们提议一种简单而有效的循环条件窗口机制,利用主干线的相接性,在全球一致的坐标框架内恢复相接相接的相对外形。 我们显示,由于全球一致的尺度,对SE(3)倍数进行图表优化就足以进行准确的大规模重建,从而排除了Sim(3)或SL(4)的优化,以及先前基于子地图的方法所采用的点-云对等.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en:
Structure-from-Motion (SfM) aims to estimate sparse point clouds and camera poses from a collection of images.
Traditional SfM pipelines ( Snavely et al., 2008 ; Schönberger and Frahm, 2016 ; Pan et al., 2024 ) typically decompose this problem into several stages: keypoint detection and correspondence matching, camera pose estimation, and joint refinement of structure and poses.
To improve the robustness and accuracy of SfM, recent works incorporate deep learning at different stages, including deep feature extraction ( DeTone et al., 2018 ; Dusmanu et al., 2019 ; Yi et al., 2016 ) and learning-based feature matching ( Sarlin et al., 2020 ; Edstedt et al., 2024 ; Pautrat et al., 2023 ; Lindenberger et al., 2023 ) .
Beyond this, another line of work explores end-to-end differentiable SfM ( Teed and Deng, 2018 ; Wei et al., 2020 ; Brachmann et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024a ) , which jointly optimizes geometry and camera poses within a unified learning framework.
blocks.zh:
结构-自动(SfM)旨在从一集图像中估计出稀有的点云和相机所呈现的相机.
传统的SfM管道(Snavely等人,2008年;Schönberger和Frahm,2016年;Pan等人,2024年)通常将这个问题分解为几个阶段:关键点检测和函授匹配,相机提出估计,以及结构和姿势的联合完善.
为了提高SfM的稳健性和准确性,近期的作品包含了不同阶段的深度学习,包括深度地物提取(DeTone等,2018;Dusmanu等,2019;Yi等,2016)和基于学习地物匹配(Sarlin等,2020;Edstedt等,2024;Pautrat等,2023;Lindenberger等,2023).
除此之外,另一行工作探索了端对端可分的SfM (Teed and Deng, 2018; Wei等, 2020; Brachmann等, 2024; Wang等, 2024a),它们共同优化了几何学和相机在统一学习框架内的功能.

blocks.en:
Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) aims to estimate camera poses and reconstruct the scene online from sequential observations.
Traditional approaches are commonly categorized into feature-based methods ( Mur-Artal et al., 2015 ; Mur-Artal and Tardós, 2017 ; Campos et al., 2021 ) and direct methods ( Engel et al., 2017 ; Engel et al., 2014 ; Newcombe et al., 2011 ) .
Feature-based methods track sparse keypoints across frames and triangulate them into a sparse map, while direct methods minimize photometric residuals over image intensities to jointly recover poses and geometry.
To improve robustness under challenging conditions like motion blur, low texture and large-scale scenes, some pipelines introduce additional sensors (IMU ( Qin et al., 2018 ; Leutenegger, 2022 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) and LiDAR ( Zhang et al., 2014 ; Shan et al., 2020 ; Xu and Zhang, 2021 ) ).
To mitigate drift over long trajectories, many systems further incorporate loop closure ( Mur-Artal et al., 2015 ; Mur-Artal and Tardós, 2017 ; Campos et al., 2021 ; Engel et al., 2014 ; Leutenegger, 2022 ) .
More recently, learning-based visual SLAM and VO systems ( Teed and Deng, 2021 ; Teed et al., 2023 ; Lipson et al., 2024 ) have demonstrated superior accuracy and robustness over their classical counterparts.
In parallel, another line of work integrates neural scene representations such as NeRF ( Zhu et al., 2022 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ) and 3D Gaussian Splatting ( Yan et al., 2024 ; Keetha et al., 2024 ; Matsuki et al., 2024 ) into SLAM, enabling photorealistic dense mapping. Despite maintaining consistency over long sequences, these carefully designed SLAM systems typically rely on iterative optimization and sophisticated pipelines.
In contrast, recent feedforward reconstruction models jointly predict scene geometry and camera poses in a single forward pass, eliminating the need for iterative optimization.
blocks.zh:
同时定位和绘图(SLAM)旨在从相继观测中估算相机的外观并在网上重建场景.
传统方法通常分为以特征为基础的方法(Mur-Artal等人,2015年;Mur-Artal和Tardós,2017年;Campos等人,2021年)和直接方法(Engel等人,2017年;Engel等人,2014年;Newcombe等人,2011年)。
基于地物的方法跟踪横跨相框的稀疏关键点,并把它们三角化成一幅稀疏的地图,而直接的方法则将光度残基最小化于图像强度以联合恢复外观和几何.
为了在运动模糊,纹理低落和大规模场景等挑战性条件下提高稳健性,一些管线引入了额外的传感器(IMU (秦等,2018;Leutenegger,2022;朱等,2026;LiDAR (张等,2014;Shan等,2020;徐等,2021)).
为了减少长轨漂移,许多系统进一步纳入了环闭(Mur-Artal等,2015年;Mur-Artal和Tardós,2017年;Campos等,2021年;Engel等,2014年;Leutenegger,2022年)。
最近,基于学习的视觉SLAM和VO系统(Teed and Deng, 2021;Teed等人, 2023;Lipson等人, 2024)已经显示出优于其古典同行的准确性和稳健性.
同时,另一行作品将神经场景表现如NERF(Zhu等,2022;Zhu等,2024)和3D高斯平板(Yan等,2024;Ketha等,2024;Matsuki等,2024)整合入了SLAM,使光现实主义密集地绘图成为可能. 尽管在长序列上保持了一致性,但这些经过精心设计的SLAM系统通常依赖于迭代优化和精密的管线.
相形之下,最近的向导重建模型联合预测了场景几何和相机在单个前行通道中的位置,从而不再需要迭代优化.

blocks.en:
Feedforward 3D Reconstruction Models predict dense 3D geometry directly from images without requiring known camera parameters.
DUSt3R ( Wang et al., 2024b ) and MASt3R ( Leroy et al., 2024 ) predict dense point clouds from an image pair within a common coordinate frame.
MonST3R ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) and Easi3R ( Chen et al., 2025a ) further extend DUSt3R to dynamic environments.
VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) and π 3 {\pi^{3}} ( Wang et al., 2025c ) support arbitrary numbers of input frames and achieve more accurate predictions.
However, their quadratic attention limits scalability to very long sequences and prohibits online streaming inference.
To address this limitation, VGGT-SLAM ( Maggio et al., 2025 ; Maggio and Carlone, 2026 ) and VGGT-Long ( Deng et al., 2025 ) extend VGGT to long sequences through submap-based alignment.
In contrast, CUT3R ( Wang et al., 2025b ) and TTT3R ( Chen et al., 2025b ) handle long sequences by continuously updating a global state representation in an online manner.
Several other streaming reconstruction works ( Elflein et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) instead leverage Test-Time Training (TTT) layers ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) to propagate information across windows with linear complexity.
Despite the rapid progress of feedforward reconstruction, existing approaches still struggle with drift accumulation in long-context streaming reconstruction.
In contrast, our method incorporates effective loop closure within the feedforward reconstruction model, enabling accurate, drift-free streaming reconstruction at the kilometer scale.
blocks.zh:
FeedForward 三维重建模型直接从图像中预测密度三维几何,而不需要已知相机参数.
DUST3R (Wang等, 2024b)和MAST3R (Leroy等, 2024)从一个共同坐标框架内的一对图像预测出密度点云.
MONST3R(张等,2024年)和Easi3R(陈等,2025a)进一步将DUST3R扩展到了动态环境.
VGGT (Wang等人, 2025a) 和 & 3 {\ pi^{3 }} (Wang等,2025c)支持任意输入帧数并实现更准确的预测.
然而,他们的四分法关注将可伸缩性限制在非常长的序列上并禁止在线流出推论.
为解决这一限制,VGGT-SLAM(Maggio等,2025;Maggio和Carlone,2026)和VGGT-Long(Deng等,2025)通过以子地图为主的对接将VGGT扩展为长序.
相形之下,CUT3R(Wang等,2025b)和TT3R(Chen等,2025b)通过在线不断更新全球状态代表,处理长序.
其他几起溪流重建工程(Elflein等,2026;Jin等,2026;张等,2026)取而代之. 测试-时间训练分层(Sun等,2024;张等,2025),跨窗口传播线性复杂信息.
尽管向上重建取得了迅速进展,但现有办法仍然与流于历史悠久的重建中的漂流积累相抗衡。
与此相反,我们的方法将有效的环路关闭纳入向导重建模式,从而能够进行准确、无漂流的千米级重建。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2 : System overview. Given a streaming monocular sequence, our method processes it in a sliding-window manner. For each window, we first tokenize the frames with a DINO-based encoder and then apply a stack of attention layers, comprising frame attention, sliding-window attention, and TTT layers, to maintain global consistency across the sequence. Upon the arrival of each new window, we additionally extract SALAD descriptors to identify potential loop closures against prior windows. When such candidates are detected, we construct a loop-conditioned window by pairing N win / 2 N_{\text{win}}/2 frames from the current window with N win / 2 N_{\text{win}}/2 frames from the corresponding prior window, predict the relative poses between loop edges from a single forward pass, and perform pose graph optimization on the SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) manifold to correct tracking drift.
blocks.zh: 图2:系统概况。 由于流体的单光子序列, 我们的方法以滑出窗的方式处理它。 对于每个窗口,我们首先用一个基于DINO的编码器对帧进行标记,然后应用一叠的注意力层,包括帧注意力,滑窗注意力和TTT层,以保持整个序列的全球一致性. 在每个新窗口到达后,我们再取出SALAD描述符,以识别针对先前窗口的潜在回路关闭. 当检测到这些候选人时,我们从当前窗口中将 N win / 2 N_{\text{win}}/2 帧与 N wintext{win}}/2 帧对齐,从相应的前窗口中将 N_{\text{win}}/2 帧对齐,从而构建出一个有循环条件的窗口,从单个前行通道中预测出循环边缘之间的相对外观,并在 SE ( 3)\mathrm{SE} (3) 上进行配置图优化,以校正跟踪漂移.

blocks.en: Our proposed method, CLoSeR , enables accurate kilometer-scale streaming reconstruction from monocular sequences by augmenting a feedforward backbone ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) with a loop closure module. In Sec. 3.1 , we introduce the preliminaries of the streaming reconstruction backbone that our framework builds upon. In Sec. 3.2 , we present loop detection and relative pose estimation between looped frames. Finally, in Sec. 3.3 , we describe the global pose graph optimization over all frames with sequential and loop closure constraints. The overview of CLoSeR is shown in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们提议的方法CLOSeR,通过用回路闭合模块来增强向上的主干线(Zhang等,2026年),从而能够从单相干序列中进行精确的千米分量流重建。 在第3.1分节中,我们介绍了我们框架所依赖的溪流重建骨干的初步情况。 在3.2第3节中,我们提出循环探测,并在被循环的框架之间相对提出估计。 最后,在3.3第3节中,我们描述了全球布局图对所有框架的优化,并附有相继和循环关闭的限制。 CLOSeR的概览见图2。

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries

blocks.en: To maintain global consistency over long sequences, LoGeR employs two mechanisms for cross-chunk information propagation. Sliding Window Attention (SWA) preserves uncompressed features from recent chunks and enables precise alignment at chunk boundaries, whereas Test-Time Training (TTT) fast weights accumulate an evolving global state that anchors the trajectory to a consistent coordinate frame and mitigates scale drift over long horizons. As a result, all per-frame poses { 𝐓 t } t = 1 N \{\mathbf{T}_{t}\}_{t=1}^{N} are expressed in a single global reference frame with consistent scale throughout inference.
blocks.zh: 为了在长序列上保持全球一致性,LoGeR使用两个机制进行跨圆通信息传播。 滑动窗口注意(SWA)保留了从最近块得到的未压缩特征并使得能精确地在块边界对齐,而测试-时间训练(TTT)快重则累积了不断变化的全球状态,将轨迹固定在一个连贯的坐标框上并减轻了长视野上的规模漂移. 因此,所有每帧表示为 {T t } t = 1 N → mathbf {T}_{t}\}_{t=t= 1}^{N } 均用一个单一的全局参考框架来表示,整个推论的尺度一致.

blocks.en: Despite these properties, LoGeR still suffers from tracking drift over long trajectories, due to error accumulation caused by the lossy compression of global information in the TTT memory and the absence of explicit revisit constraints in the feedforward inference. This motivates us to build a loop closure framework on top of LoGeR. Two properties of the backbone make it particularly well suited as a frontend for loop closure: its chunk-based forward pass places no requirement on the temporal contiguity of input frames, and its pose outputs across chunks already share a common global scale. Exploiting these properties, we introduce a loop closure module on top of the LoGeR backbone, which estimates relative poses between looped frames under a consistent scale and enforces the resulting constraints through pose graph optimization.
blocks.zh: 尽管具有这些属性,LoGeR仍然在跟踪长轨上的漂移,这是由于TTT内存中全球信息压缩失常而导致的误差积累,以及feedforward推断中没有明确的重温限制. 这促使我们在LoGeR上方建立环闭合框架. 骨干网的两种特性使它特别适合作为环路关闭的前端:其以块为主的前行不要求输入框的时间相接性,其跨块的外形输出已经具有共同的全球规模。 探索这些属性,我们引入了LoGeR主干上方的回路关闭模块,该模块在一致的尺度下估计了回路框之间的相对构成,并通过平面图优化强制执行所形成的制约.

blocks.en:
We evaluate our method on (a) three representative long-context reconstruction benchmarks: the VBR dataset ( Brizi et al., 2024 ) , the autonomous driving benchmark KITTI Odometry ( Geiger et al., 2013 ) , and the challenging Oxford Spires dataset ( Tao et al., 2024 ) ; and (b) one outdoor dynamic benchmark, DROID-W ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
VBR is captured in Rome and provides RGB sequences, 3D point clouds, IMU measurements, and ground-truth trajectories obtained via bundle adjustment.
Following LoGeR, we evaluate on 7 VBR sequences ranging from 8,815 to 18,846 frames and 1.45 to 5.2 km in trajectory length, all containing loops.
KITTI Odometry comprises 11 sequences with long, loop-containing trajectories of up to 4,661 frames and 5.1 km.
Oxford Spires consists of 14 sequences spanning indoor and outdoor scenes with challenging loop closures, ranging from 3,961 to 15,803 frames and 294 to 925 m in length.
DROID-W contains 7 challenging dynamic sequences captured outdoors, ranging from 1,427 to 2,200 frames and 62 to 130 m in length.
We report Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE) to evaluate tracking accuracy, and align estimated trajectories with the groundtruth via Sim(3) Umeyama alignment ( Umeyama, 1991 ) .

Camera tracking comparisons on four benchmarks are reported in Tables 1 , 2 , 3 , and 4 .
As shown in Table 1 and Table 2 , both VBR and KITTI consist of kilometer-scale sequences, on which our approach substantially outperforms LoGeR / LoGeR* ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , as our loop closure module effectively handles revisited regions. We further compare against classical deep visual SLAM systems.

In contrast, our approach remains robust, benefiting from strong 3D reconstruction priors and effective loop closure.

We report ablations of several design choices in Table 5 .
In variant (b), we set N seq = 1 N_{\text{seq}}=1 to enforce neighbor-only sequential constraints; the resulting performance drop shows that denser sequential constraints provide stronger short-range regularization of the trajectory.
In variant (c), removing the Huber loss degrades performance, confirming its effectiveness in down-weighting outlier loop constraints.
In variant (d), we replace our SE(3) pose graph with a Sim(3) formulation that additionally optimizes per-frame scale.
Since our loop closure window inherits scale consistency from the streaming backbone, the extra scale degrees of freedom introduce optimization ambiguity and lead to inferior accuracy.
In variant (e), we further replace it with an SL(4) formulation proposed in VGGT-SLAM, whose 15-DOF projective transformation introduces more degrees of freedom than necessary in our setting, resulting in additional performance degradation. Overall, our full method achieves the best performance, validating the effectiveness of each design choice.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en:
We present a feedforward streaming reconstruction method that incorporates loop closure to substantially reduce drift over kilometer-scale trajectories. However, when the underlying odometry suffers not from accumulated drift but from complete failure, our method cannot recover the correct trajectory.
Such failures arise when the feedforward frontend (LoGeR in our case) is pushed beyond its operating conditions, e.g., in highly dynamic environments or under aggressive camera motion.
blocks.zh:

这种失败是在前端(LoGeR in our case)被推出其操作条件之外时发生的,例如,在极活泼的环境中,或是在激进相机运动下发生的.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented CLoSeR , a streaming reconstruction framework that revisits loop closure within a feedforward backbone, enabling accurate kilometer-scale reconstruction from uncalibrated monocular videos without any retraining. By exploiting the globally consistent scale of the streaming backbone LoGeR, we introduce a loop-conditioned window mechanism that recovers relative poses between looped frames directly in the global coordinate system. Our experiments demonstrate that pose graph optimization on the SE(3) manifold is sufficient within our framework, avoiding the Sim(3) or SL(4) optimization adopted by prior submap-based methods.
In future work, we aim to improve the robustness of our framework under challenging conditions such as motion blur, low-texture regions, and exposure variations. We also plan to explore multi-agent collaborative reconstruction and online deployment, broadening its applicability to real-world large-scale environments.
blocks.zh:

在今后的工作中,我们的目标是在运动模糊、低文本和暴露差异等具有挑战性的条件下,提高我们框架的稳健性。 我们还计划探索多代理人合作重建和在线部署,将它扩大到现实世界的大规模环境。

blocks.en: A.3 Runtime and GPU Memory Analysis
blocks.zh: A.3 运行时间和GPU内存分析

blocks.en: We evaluate the runtime and GPU memory usage of our method compared with LoGeR Zhang et al. (2026) . All experiments are conducted on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU paired with 4 cores of an AMD EPYC 9554 CPU on a Slurm cluster. As shown in Table 6 , our method incurs only marginal runtime overhead, achieving 7.12 FPS compared with 7.60 FPS for LoGeR (a 6.3% reduction in throughput), while reducing peak GPU memory usage from 16.65 GiB to 15.69 GiB (a 5.8% reduction) due to our efficient optimization. The additional cost mainly stems from our loop closure detection and the additional loop closure windows for model inference. In exchange, our method nearly halves trajectory error, reducing ATE RMSE from 25.44 m to 12.66 m – a substantial accuracy gain at marginal runtime cost.
